name: hf-helper-onset-noise-support
purpose: Default .25s capture pre-roll does not provide the native Helper onset estimator its required .25s filtered noise support after .3s capture-edge and .4s pre-onset exclusions. Preserve original results and default. Use supported public2s capture lead, as canonical positive Helper tests do: one bright AWGN Helper control at40dB-Hz, then original bright O/X20dB-Hz seed10103. Both use canonical native source, actual Helper search, full public DATA fallback, and physical quiet completion; no thresholds or algorithm changes. Report actual Helper status separately from complete DATA. Capture lead changes absolute channel time relative to TX, so O/X comparison is not an exact phase-matched pre-roll ablation. Stop after these two rows regardless of result; no tuning for desired lock.
